text: 工业和信息化部总工程师王卫明在国新办新闻发布会上表示，当前外部环境复杂严峻，国内供强需弱、结构性矛盾仍然突出，但我国产业体系全、韧性强的优势明显，各项改革举措和支持政策持续发力，工业经济发展稳中向好的基本面没有改变。下一步，我们将聚焦高质量发展这一首要任务，更好统筹发展和安全，印发实施工信领域行业、专题“十五五”规划，加快构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系，不断提升工业经济运行质效，保持工业和信息化经济平稳发展，实现“十五五”良好开局。
text_en: Wang Weiming, Chief Engineer of MIIT, said at a press conference that while the external environment is complex and severe, and domestic supply-demand imbalances and structural issues persist, China's complete industrial system and strong resilience provide advantages. The fundamentals of steady industrial economic development remain unchanged. Next, MIIT will focus on high-quality development, coordinate development and security, issue industry-specific plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan, accelerate building a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing, and ensure a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.
